artifacts.summary: 16-phase staged enablement of mathlibStandardSet: package-level enable with temporary per-class opt-outs, one phase per linter class (longLine split 4 ways), bounded fallback for unusedDecidableInType, C30 blanket-suppression ratchet, policy docs and final --wfail gate.

memory_candidates.content: Adopting a warning-emitting linter set under a CI that builds with --wfail: stage enablement by turning the whole set on in the lakefile plus a temporary per-class `weak.linter.X = false` opt-out, then one phase per class takes it to zero and deletes its line. Keeps the build green every phase and avoids a non-zero warning baseline (which --wfail forbids). Verify per file during a phase with `lake env lean -Dweak.linter.X=true` (ignores lakefile options, writes no oleans) and edit the lakefile only at phase close, since every leanOptions change forces a full rebuild. Put the option in a package-level [leanOptions] table so lean_exe roots are covered.
